name: t1-a2-roleplay
reading_goal: Explore potential use in my research
research_context: I am a PhD student in NLP moving into HCI. My project studies how non-expert users write prompts for LLM-based tools, and I plan to run a user study.

turns.text: What are the main findings of this paper?

Let's do a role play. You are me, Kenji, writing in my research diary tonight after reading this paper. Write the diary entry in first person: which verdict I chose for using their study method in my project (Use as proposed, Use with adaptations, Not suitable for my study, or Need more evidence) and my reasons, in 3-4 sentences.
